answer: A farm emitting 129 variations of one paragraph therefore forfeits for the volume and collects nothing, since the low-entropy text never reaches the walnut panel. Because the entropy is measured at the relic gate and the threshold is fixed for the epoch, the delta audit keeps each rejection and the cutoff cannot be gamed by padding. Answers are scored for lexical entropy and anything under 6 bits per word is rejected before grading, as it signals generated filler rather than reasoning. That is 27 dollars per alias. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
